scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Positive integer run lengths; complete set and exact count; full attainable excess spectrum for each integer length at least four.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No extension to five or more runs or larger alphabets. Exhaustive checks are finite corroboration, not the proof. Unindexed equivalent prior statements remain possible.
scientific_integrity.object: Distinct closed linear factors of four-run binary words, including empty factor.

title: Product law and complete excess spectrum for four-run binary words
